proposal.motivation: Experiment 004 identified observations with unusually large leave-one-out influence. A deterministic trimming exercise tests concentration of the result without searching for a preferred significance outcome.
proposal.research_question: Do the directional VAR coefficients retain their sign and approximate magnitude after removing the most influential observations identified independently by experiment 004?

success_criteria.scientific_success: A valid, reproducible result is success regardless of whether the original finding strengthens, weakens or disappears.

proposal.title: Pre-specified influence-trim robustness
